results.segment: Your appointment about your check-up with Fenwick Dental Practice is booked for 6 January 2027 at 4.05pm.
Please arrive promptly, as late arrivals cannot always be seen.

obligations.ask: Take a ticket from the machine and bring proof of address

results.segment: Please take a ticket from the machine as you come in, and bring a recent proof of your address with you on the day.
Please come to the desk marked Appointments.
Please do not arrive more than half an hour early, and order a replacement card before your appointment.
If the date no longer suits you, our reception team can offer another.
There is no charge for this service and none will be raised.
